name: Tigecycline
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Tigecycline is eliminated mainly in bile; about 22% of a dose appears unchanged in urine. The US label needs no dose change in kidney impairment or on hemodialysis, which does not remove it. Severe liver impairment (Child-Pugh C) needs a lower maintenance dose, and the label carries a boxed warning on higher all-cause mortality.
kidney_function_basis: Label PK uses CrCl (mL/min); no dose bands.

crrt: Not in label. Li 2020 (Table 3): no change in CVVH, CVVHD or CVVHDF.
dialyzable: No: not removed in significant quantities by hemodialysis (label). Protein binding 71% to 89%.
monitoring: Coagulation tests including fibrinogen at baseline and regularly; liver tests; pancreatitis symptoms (label).
